# Reading Fixation Time (Eye-tracking)

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
```

```{r}
fix_dur <- read.csv("./data/berzak2025/fix-dur.csv")

#fixayion durations
fix_dur |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(CURRENT_FIX_DURATION, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(CURRENT_FIX_DURATION, na.rm = TRUE)) 

```

```{r}
fix_dur |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = CURRENT_FIX_DURATION)) +
      geom_density() +
      labs(
        x = "Fixation Durantion (ms)",
        y = "Density"
      )

```

```{r}
fixdr_brm <- brm(
  formula = CURRENT_FIX_DURATION ~ 1,
  family = gaussian,
  data = fix_dur
)
```

```{r}
summary(fixdr_brm)
```
